claims.text: The hotel is on Hong Kong Island, facing Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: Situated on Hong Kong Island facing the world-famous Victoria Harbour, Grand Hyatt Hong Kong redefines hotel luxury
findings.note: The official page states both the island location and that the hotel faces the harbour.

claims.text: The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Exit B3 of Exhibition Centre station on the East Rail Line.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Hong Kong is a 5-minute walk from the Exit B3 of the Exhibition Centre station (East Rail Line).
findings.note: Walking time, exit, station and line all match.

claims.text: Guestrooms and suites are designed to blend traditional and modern aesthetics in an elegant, residential style.

findings.quote: Unwind in one of the 542 spacious guestrooms or suites, designed to blend traditional and modern aesthetics in an elegant, residential style.
findings.note: The wording matches the claim.

claims.text: Many of the rooms and suites have views of Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: Our hotel features 542 diverse and unique rooms and suites, with many commanding stunning views of Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: Set your sights on a 180-degree view of the Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline in this spacious 65-square metre suite.
